02 Mobility support - - - Rs.3,000/-
 Remuneration Rs.17,000/- per month per radiographer at the rate of Rs.680/- per day
for 25 days in a month plus Rs.3,000/-per month per radiographer towards mobility
support for a period of 8 months from August 2026 to March 2027.
Roles and Responsibilities of Radiographers:
1. Conduct chest X-ray examinations using handheld/mobile X-ray equipment for TB screening under NTEP,
following prescribed protocols, radiation safety standards and infection prevention practices.
2. Provide chest X-ray services during Active Case Finding (ACF), Passive Case Finding (PCF), outreach
activities, screening camps, health melas, special drives and other TB case-finding activities as directed by
the District TB Officer (DTO).
3. Ensure quality and timely availability Of X-ray images, including proper identification and labelling of
images and timely upload/transfer through the designated digital platform for interpretation and further
clinical action.
4. Coordinate with the District TB team and healthcare staff, including Medical Officers, STS, STLS, TB Health
Visitors and other field staff, for appropriate referral, sputum/sample collection and follow-up Of
individuals identified as presumptive TB.
5. Maintain accurate records and submit daily reports to the DTO/NTEP district team on individuals
screened, X-rays performed, activity location/type, presumptive TB identified, referrals and other
programme indicators as prescribed.
6. Ensure proper maintenance, safe handling and operational readiness Of handheld/mobile X-ray
equipment and promptly report any malfunction, damage, shortage or technical issues to the concerned
authority.
7. Support the DTO in planning and mapping X-ray-based TB screening activities.
8. Support data validation, reconciliation and reporting Of chest X-ray screening and TB case-finding
activities and ensure completeness and accuracy of programme data.
9. Participate in N TEP training, review meetings, monitoring and capacity- building activities and adhere to
all prescribed technical, radiation safety, confidentiality and patient privacy requirements.
10. Undertake any other duties related to TB screening, diagnosis and case finding as assigned by the District
TB Officer / District Health Officer in the interest Of the programme.
11. Coordinate with the three Directorates at the district level and the Block Medical Officers in planning and
implementing camps and other screening-related activities.
12. Radiographers engaged shall be deployed for operation of HHX Ray units ensuring quality chest
radiographs, supporting Active Case Finding campaigns in high risk and hard to reach populations and
ensuring linkage of screened individuals to diagnostic and treatment services.
TERMS AND CONDITIONS
 Only residents of Sivaganga District are eligible to apply.
 The candidate’s age should be below 45 years.
The required documents must be submitted along with the application.
 Updated Bio-data with a recent photograph.
 Educational qualification / Ration Card / Voter ID
 Relevant experience certificate, if applicable.
 Affix ₹10/- rupees stamp - Self-addressed envelope (4 × 10 inches).
 Filled application should be submitted only through post.
 The application is to be download from the site : sivaganga.nic.in
The application should be submitted to:
The Deputy Director of Medical Services (TB),
District TB Centre,
Old Government Head Quarters Hospital Campus,
Sivaganga – 630 561.
Note :
 Last date for submission of applications: 10-11-2026 (Tuesday).
 After scrutiny of applications, eligible candidates will be informed about the interview
through post.
 Applications received after the last date, applications without required documents, and
applications without complete details will be summarily rejected.
